programme.title: Golmaal: Fun Unlimited
programme.desc: The story revolves around the lives of four guys named Gopal, Lucky, Madhav, and Laxman who all absurdly fall for the same girl. Hence, begins the hilarious race to win her heart.

programme.title: Amar Akbar Anthony
programme.desc: A family of five is separated in an unfortunate incident. The three brothers are raised in different religious households. As fate would have it, the family reunites after several years and avenges those responsible for their separation.

programme.title: Rajnigandha
programme.desc: Deepa (Vidya Sinha), a highly qualified girl with simple dreams, is betrothed to Sanjay (Amol Palekar), a forgetful, tardy but lovable and caring boyfriend. Deepa goes to Mumbai for a job interview and chances upon Navin (Dinesh Thakur), her old boyfriend from college who was a passionate youngster and has now become a responsible and successful man. Through the course of the story, Deepa finds herself caught in a dilemma as she reminisces her past with Navin and her future with Sanjay. Will Navin's sudden appearance in her life change her heart?

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Barah Aana' is a story of three impoverished roommates and friends - a driver, a security guard and a waiter. The security guard finds a seemingly low-risk way of making easy money and tries to entice the others to join him in a series of offenses. Will the friends team up with him?

programme.title: Ek Rishtaa - The Bond of Love…
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman and his son Ajay quarrel over Ajay's ways of handling the family business and have an ugly fall out. Despite the fall out, Ajay jumps in to help when he realises that a family member is bent on bringing down his father's empire.

programme.title: Jaanwar
programme.desc: A perilous criminal Sultan raises an orphan, who also grows up to become a criminal, known as Badshah. Badshah changes his ways after he falls in love with a street performer Sapna, but Sultan returns to remind Sultan of his past.

programme.title: Ishqiya
programme.desc: Khalujaan and Babban, two thugs, are on the run from their boss. They seek refuge at an old friend’s house but meet Krishna, his widow, instead. Both of them fall for her, oblivious to the fact that Krishna is manipulating them for her own gain.

programme.title: Dhamaal
programme.desc: Four slack and vagabond conmen learn about a hidden treasure from a dying thief and race against time to claim it. Meanwhile, they are also being pursued by a determined police inspector who is hell-bent on finding the treasure and keeping it all to himself.
